description: Minimal Unscroll webview access: core window, app, event, and resource APIs only (the pinned Tauri 2 build autogenerates core:default from those core plugins; shell, process, filesystem, dialog, notification, updater, and HTTP plugins are not dependencies, so they cannot be granted). Device access, exports, and diagnostics stay behind the Rust boundary. Handoff for Tasks 18/19: the webview has no save-dialog permission, so diagnostic export takes only explicit absolute destinations until a save-picker affordance lands.
